notes: Recorded 46 English-taught master's rows (one row per school and major code, so a major offered by two schools appears twice; 13 schools linked, 12 had a readable PDF) and 69 English-taught doctoral rows (23 schools linked, 20 had a readable PDF). The source states no total. These are the full contents of every readable 2027 English-taught catalogue PDF; the first pass had read the older 2025 catalogue.

The 2027 catalogue is shorter than the 2025 one for master's majors. Majors that the first pass stored from the 2025 catalogue and that the 2027 master's catalogue no longer lists: Environmental Engineering (083002), International Relations (030207; the 2027 catalogue has International Affairs 035500 instead), Civil and Commercial Law (030105; the 2027 catalogue has Juris 035102 instead), Political Economy (020101), Population, Resource and Environmental Economics (020106), Demography (030302), Gerontology (030320). The 2027 doctoral catalogue still lists 020106 and 030302 at doctoral level.

The English-taught PDFs of four schools are broken links (the server returns "not found"): School of Foreign Languages (master's and doctoral), Department of History (doctoral) and School of Advanced Agricultural Sciences (doctoral). The Chinese-taught catalogue PDFs of the same four schools name only Chinese as teaching language for every major, so no English-taught major of these schools is recorded.

The 2027 master's catalogue no longer links the National School of Development (listed in 2025) and the 2027 doctoral catalogue adds schools such as Mechanics and Engineering Science, Integrated Circuits, Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics, Urban and Environmental Sciences, Philosophy, Marxism and Information Management.
Peking University Health Science Center has its own guidelines; its 2027 master's and doctoral catalogues for international students are labelled Chinese-taught, so no HSC major is recorded.
Research fields inside each major (for example 33 fields under Pure Mathematics) are not recorded as separate programmes; counts are given in the detail text where useful.

Programmes such as MBA, MiM, IMPA, MPP, MIA, the PKU-LSE and PKU-Sciences Po double masters, the LLM in Chinese Law, the Yenching Academy China Studies degree and the Cornell and Northwestern joint programmes appear in the catalogue as majors or research fields and are included under the major that carries them.

fetch_problems: The English-taught catalogue PDFs of the School of Foreign Languages (master's and doctoral), Department of History (doctoral) and School of Advanced Agricultural Sciences (doctoral) return "not found"; their Chinese-taught PDFs were read and list only Chinese-taught majors.
The Chinese characters in the English-taught PDFs are lost in some text extractors; the English names and codes were read from the same files with another extractor.
